[workspace]
members = ["crates/*"]
resolver = "3"

[workspace.package]
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.85"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"

[workspace.dependencies]
serde_json = "1.0"
wordstat = { path = "crates/wordstat", version = "0.1.0" }

[workspace.lints.rust]
unsafe_code = "forbid"
missing_docs = "warn"

[workspace.lints.clippy]
dbg_macro = "warn"
rust.crates/wordstat/Cargo.toml:
[package]
name = "wordstat"
description = "Count the words in a piece of text"
default-run = "wordstat"
version.workspace = true
edition.workspace = true
rust-version.workspace = true
license.workspace = true

[features]
# Off by default: `Stats::to_json` and the `dump` program need serde_json.
json = ["dep:serde_json"]

[dependencies]
serde_json = { workspace = true, optional = true }

[[bin]]
name = "dump"
required-features = ["json"]

[lints]
workspace = true
rust.crates/wordstat-report/Cargo.toml:
[package]
name = "wordstat-report"
version.workspace = true
edition.workspace = true
rust-version.workspace = true
license.workspace = true
publish = false

[dependencies]
wordstat = { workspace = true, features = ["json"] }

[lints]
workspace = true
